# Amazon Translate

Return exact user-registered translation fixtures and run local fixture-backed S3 batch jobs.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `translate` |
| Signing name | `translate` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.1, Smithy RPC v2 CBOR |
| API version | `2017-07-01` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Fixture-backed local translation; no inference |
| Selected operations | 19 of 19 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#amazon-translate) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No translation inference, language detection model, terminology application or parallel-data application; missing or ambiguous fixtures fail explicitly.
- Nonempty translation Settings fail explicitly; AppliedTerminologies remains empty and fixtures are returned verbatim.
- GetTerminology fails explicitly because a retrievable presigned download URL is not implemented.
- Only text/plain and text/html documents/batch inputs; no remote S3, role assumption, document format conversion or encrypted data execution.
- S3 writes are not atomic with job state; cancellation or process interruption can leave partial output objects.
- Terraform AWS provider 6.70 has no Translate resources; the current official CloudFormation specification does include Translate types, contrary to the original task note.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
